BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Library input can come from a remote caller of a consuming application.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Exploitation depends on how consuming applications pass input to the library.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No privileges are needed once a consuming application forwards input.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No victim action is needed once input reaches the library.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Commands run with the process privileges on the same host.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Arbitrary commands can read any file the process can access.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Arbitrary commands can modify files, data and application code.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Impact on availability is limited because exploitation depends on the consuming application.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
